purpose: Feedback/model adequacy diagnostics only, not a new controller or formal efficacy comparison
conditions: Fresh default1/1, four initial nodes, emptyload2mm/1200-1200/HW6, unchanged trajectory/gains/guards/allocator
capture: At actual10ms intervals throughout20s: relative raw encoder counts, rawRPM, feedback-current counts, attempted queued commands. Bounded2048x18byte RAM buffer. Exact timestamps, no missing-data interpolation.
telemetry: 107floats/40ms/115200 unchanged; after phase6 only, MODEL4435 two copies per row in I96..I103; fault replay takes priority
rawEncoderSigns: Left raw count increases with positive position; right raw count decreases. Do not treat raw right count as already-inverted position.
currentUnits: Raw motor feedback/command counts, not calibrated amperes or force measurements
analysis: Check encoder/RPM consistency, command/current response and prediction error. Fit only identifiable effective dynamics; closed-loop identification bias and limited excitation must be evaluated. No claims that10ms resolves every1ms dynamics or proves a physical plant model.
deadline: 2026-10-14 09:00 Asia/Shanghai best effort; no guarantee of successful research conclusion
